richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Junagadh

c: Climbing the steps of Girnar is a local test of fitness in Junagadh, and step and leg machines are what many walkers here ask for first. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to colleges, schools, housing societies, temple and trust grounds and public gardens in Junagadh. We build the machines at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 350 km away, and send them to Saurashtra by road.

Leg strength and stamina matter most for anyone planning the Girnar climb, but a good gym also needs something for the core and upper body. We suggest a small, balanced set. Saurashtra has hot summers and a short monsoon, so the machines face more sun than rain. Our installers or a dealer in western India fix each base, grouted or self-standing. Send us photos of the site and we will return a layout drawing.

items.q: Which outdoor gym machines help with stair climbing?
items.a: The Step Trainer, leg press machines and walkers build leg strength and stamina. An ab bench helps the core, which supports the body on a long climb.

items.q: Can a temple trust or college order outdoor gym equipment?
items.a: Yes. We supply trusts, colleges, schools and societies. Send the site size and photos, and we will suggest machines with a layout drawing and quote.

items.q: How far is Junagadh from your factory?
items.a: About 350 km by road from Vasai, which keeps transport simple. We install through our own team or a dealer in western India, as per the approved layout.
